review_candidates.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You will be responsible for maintaining secure, scalable, and highly available cloud and infrastructure services while partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable business solutions. Manage and maintain Windows Server, Linux, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure platforms to ensure stability, performance, and security. Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (SSO), SAML, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Service Principals, Managed Identities
eligibility_evidence: Manage and maintain Windows Server, Linux, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure platforms to ensure stability, performance, and security.
Typical responsibilities include: Managing and supporting infrastructure across Azure Commercial, Azure Government, AWS, and hybrid environments.
5+ years of experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud, and hybrid environments.
Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, AWS, and hybrid cloud environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Collaborate with security, networking, database, and application teams to implement solutions that meet business and regulatory requirements. Implementing and maintaining security controls to meet organizational and regulatory requirements, including NIST, CMMC, ITAR, and FedRAMP frameworks. 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud, and hybrid environments. Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, AWS, and hybrid cloud environments. Experience supporting environments subject to government, defense, or regulated industry compliance requirements such as NIST, CMMC, ITAR, or FedRAMP. Proficiency with automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Terraform, or cloud-native automation tools.
